votes.motion: A motion was made by Monica Zoltanski, seconded by Brooke Christensen, to approve the Consent Calendar: Items 4, 5, 6

A motion was made by Kristin Coleman-Nicholl, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey, approve - adopt Ordinance #21-01, an ordinance amending and fixing the boundaries of a zone district of the Sandy City Zoning Ordinance; rezoning approximately 8.1 acres located at the intersection of Wasatch Boulevard and Little Cottonwood Road from the R-1-15 Zone "Single Family Residential District" to the OS Zone "Open Space District"
A motion was made by Kris Coleman-Nicholl, seconded by Marci Houseman to bring the Utah Compact on Racial Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion through to the Consent Calendar for adoption
